resolution: The ontological variants differ in their domain, not in their thesis predicate: N1 quantifies over everything existing, N2 over existing concreta, N3 over bearers of causal power and N3i over causes of things satisfying the predicate. Each is a separate statement. N1 entails N2 with no premise (NATURALISM-N1-ENTAILS-N2); the other pairs need bridges: N2 gives N3 only with the causal-concreteness floor item, and N3 and N3i are related only through the exercise-to-power reading. Under the owner's #1113 bridge (whatever exists in re is concrete), N1 and N2 coincide for existents in re; N1 differs only where something exists without esse in re, as a Platonist number would. The methodological variants (STMT-SELLARS-SCIENTIA-MENSURA, STMT-QUINE-NATURALIZED-EPISTEMOLOGY) are about method, not domain, and are recorded untyped.
